ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Better Work Tab v2.0 overhauls RimWorld's Work tab with drag-and-drop, skill overlays, automation rules, sub-work jobs, time priority schedules, extended priorities, and visual customization.
Features are toggleable in settings.
Features: - Drag and drop work column and pawn row reordering - Extended max priorities from vanilla 4 up to 99 - Sub-work job drilldown with global and pawn-specific priorities - Time-of-day priority schedules for work and sub-work jobs - Skill level overlay (hold SHIFT) - Auto-assignment rulesets - Rule Builder 2.0 for work automation - Workload presets - Visual dividers - Force pawns to work on unassigned tasks - Advanced pawn and column highlighting - Angled or vanilla-style column headers - Colonist and bed counts - Right-click pawn quick actions - Modern priority-cell rendering toggle for legacy versions - Detailed settings for UI, priorities, rules, workloads, and layout
Compatibility: - Grouped Pawns List is overridden inside this Work tab - CompactWorkTab overlaps this UI and should not be used together - Fluffy WorkTab and forks are hard conflicts
Version support: - 0.16 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work
Support: Discord: https://discord.gg/QYBBaRkKWs
